== Summary ==
Identified: [[Nathan Davis]] (standing, blue Seattle cap and a black Star Wars tee; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]]), [[Jacy Smith]] (seated, heavy-set, dark grey shirt and teal shorts; same shirt, shorts, and build as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 7.jpg]]), and [[Nathan Russell]] (standing left, navy tee, seen from the side; same navy tee as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 7.jpg]]). Remaining: the standing player in a grey cap; the seated player in a black graphic tee and glasses ("ALPINE VADER 24"); and the seated player in a navy tee, seen from behind.


The 2025 Oregon State Championship in a private basement in Portland (21 June 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 State Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2025-06-22
* '''Camera date:''' 2025-06-21
* '''Identification:''' [[Nathan Davis]] (standing, blue Seattle cap and a black Star Wars tee; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]]), [[Jacy Smith]] (seated, heavy-set, dark grey shirt and teal shorts; same shirt, shorts, and build as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 7.jpg]]), and [[Nathan Russell]] (standing left, navy tee, seen from the side; same navy tee as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 7.jpg]]). Remaining: the standing player in a grey cap; the seated player in a black graphic tee and glasses ("ALPINE VADER 24"); and the seated player in a navy tee, seen from behind.
